name: Smoked haddock kedgeree
steps: Poach the smoked haddock in milk for five minutes, then flake it.
Fry the onion with curry powder until soft and fragrant.
Stir the cooked rice through the spiced onion to warm.
Fold in the flaked haddock and quartered boiled egg.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and chopped parsley.
